title: Bunny Squad
description: Tame wild rabbits with sweet berries to create loyal combat companions! Your tamed bunnies will follow you, sit on command, and fiercely defend you from monsters with rainbow particle attacks. Turn cute rabbits into your personal army.
body:
🐇 Turn Wild Rabbits into Loyal Warriors! 🍓⚔️

Feed sweet berries to tame wild rabbits and unlock their hidden potential! Your tamed bunnies will:

🐾 Follow you wherever you go

🪑 Sit on command when you need a break

🌈 Defend you with dazzling rainbow particle attacks

Who knew cute little bunnies could become your ultimate combat squad? 🐰💥

For support or inquiries, message me on discord:
procurer
